agent_brief: Beautiful portfolio, almost no posting. Instagram is the obvious channel for interiors. LinkedIn is dead weight for them. They have hundreds of unpublished project photos.
headline: You have three years of finished projects and almost none of it has been posted.
intro: Interiors is one of the few industries where the work sells itself on sight, and Instagram is where people look. You have 1,240 followers and post roughly twice a month; the two studios you named as competitors post four times a week and have eleven times the audience. LinkedIn is not worth your money here and we would not charge you to manage it.

content_pillars.name: Finished rooms
content_pillars.description: One completed space per post, shot properly, with the brief and the budget band named. This is what gets saved and shared.

content_pillars.name: Before and after
content_pillars.description: The single highest-performing format in interiors. Split-frame reels from your existing project archive.

content_pillars.name: Sourcing and detail
content_pillars.description: Close-ups of materials, why a fabric or finish was chosen. Builds the taste-authority that justifies your fee.

content_pillars.name: Studio and process
content_pillars.description: The team, site visits, the messy middle. Makes an expensive service feel like people rather than a quote.

monthly_deliverables: 20 Instagram posts including 8 reels, written and scheduled
32 Pinterest pins linked back to project pages
Monthly content shoot direction for your photographer
Community management — comments and DMs answered within 4 hours on weekdays
Monthly performance report with the three posts worth repeating
projection_note: This projection assumes the posting cadence above is maintained and that we get access to the project archive in month one. It is based on typical results for design studios at this audience size, not a promise — social platforms change what they show and nobody controls that.

pricing_tiers.name: Instagram focus
features: Content calendar you can see and approve

pricing_tiers.name: Full studio
features: Paid promotion management if you choose to run it

payment_terms: Monthly in advance. Three-month minimum, then thirty days notice.
closing_note: The archive is the reason this works. Most studios we take on need six weeks of shooting before there is anything to post — you already have three years of it sitting unused.
disclaimer: Follower and engagement projections are estimates based on current account performance and comparable accounts in this sector. Social platforms control distribution and results cannot be guaranteed.
